title: UserAppkey
description:
A user appkey which is registered to an app on a device.

**NOTE** The device information is only available if the `DEVICE_INFO` extension is enabled in the appkey registration policy.

regPolicyName.description: The relying party's registration policy name.

appId.description: The appId set in the appkey configuration. If the configured appId is nullthen this value is the same as the facetId.

keyId.description: The ID of the appkey credential generated by the client authenticator.

aaid.description: Identifies the type of appkey authenticator.

deviceId.description: Identifies the device on which the appkey was generated.

status.description: The appkey status: ACTIVE or DISABLED.

regCounter.description: The appkey registration counter. How many registrations have been performed by the authenticator.

signCounter.description: The appkey signature counter. How many authentications have been performed by the authenticator.

publicKey.description: The public key associated with the authenticator. Used to verify authenticator assertions.

privateInfo.description: Contains private info which is encrypted at rest. In this case the device information.

lastUsedDtm.description: If the key has been used for authentication this field indicates the last time this occurred

DeviceInfo.description: Information extracted from the device where the appkey resides

appId.description: Identifies the device app which owns the appkey

deviceId.description:
Identifies the device on which the app resides

**NOTE** This identifier is not trustworthy and is not used. The `appId` is used throughout the system as the proxy device ID because it is always available.

osType.description: The device OS type, for example `android`

notificationToken.description: A push notification token provided by the device

healthCheckPassed.description:
Whether the device health check passed
Only available if the `HEALTH_CHECK` extension is enabled in the appkey registration policy

environmentCheckResult.description:
The device environment. Possibly values:
- **Passed**: App cannot be debugged and is not running in an emulator.
- **Emulator**: App is running in an emulator.
- **Debugger**: App can be debugged.
Only available if the `ENVIRONMENT_CHECK` extension is enabled in the appkey registration policy
